visualCharacteristics.description: Photo background (home-cta-bg) with dark bottom gradient overlay; centered H2, paragraph, purple button | White text centered | Contained photo banner with dark bottom gradient overlay, centered H2, paragraph and single button

contentPattern.structure: row 1 holds the background image; row 2 holds an H2, a paragraph and a button link
contentPattern.rationale: Photo background with overlaid centered CTA text is a hero; photo belongs to the block, section not colored

usage: Closing photo banner with gradient overlay, centered H2, paragraph and one button.
reuseGuidance: Use for mid/bottom-of-page call-to-action banners with a photo background. Use hero-video for video backgrounds.
